integrity: Counts are generated by the included standalone Python program.
The face-count distribution is checked by two independent tracers.
The orbit count is checked by direct enumeration and Burnside's lemma.
scientific_limitations: Exhaustive only for the 16384 rotation systems of the fixed Heawood graph.
Does not classify metric realizations, curvature, geodesic lengths, or cut-locus stability.
An unindexed specialized map-enumeration source may contain the same counts.
title: Exact one-face rotation census of the Heawood graph
